sources.summary: APY Lands artist Robert Fielding has won the 2026 Hadley’s art prize, awarded to the most outstanding portrayal of Australian landscape. The judges said Fielding’s painting, which depicts stacked, wrecked cars, ‘revealed ‘a landscape which is lived and still sacred’. It will be exhibited with 26 other finalists at Hadley’s Orient hotel in Hobart from 1 to 23 August Continue reading...
